parameters.help_en:
Specifies the region ID of the bastion host on which you want to create a public key for the user.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定需创建用户公钥的用户所在的堡垒机的区域id。
区域id和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to create a public key for the user.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建用户公钥的堡垒机实例id。

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user for whom you want to create a public key.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to query the user ID

parameters.name: public_key

parameters.help_en: The description of the public key. The description can be up to 500 characters in length
